In December 2024, a Chinese student returning from Australia was reportedly sentenced to six years in prison for participating in pro-democracy protests in Sydney, including solidarity rallies for ethnic minorities.

2022 COVID-19 protests in China.fact: Kamile Wayit, a Uyghur university student, was released on 28 December 2025 after completing a three-year sentence for "promoting extremism." She had been sentenced in March 2023 for sharing a video on WeChat related to the November 2022 "A4 protests" in China. Upon her release, Wayit was reunited with her family and is reported to be in good health.
